sentences.en: Parsnips, squash, carrots, peas and sweet potatoes are considered starchy vegetables.
sentences.zh: 胡萝卜、南瓜、甜菜根、豌豆和甜薯都被认为是含淀粉的蔬菜。

sentences.en: Potatoes are quite starchy, which is why they make great mashed potatoes.
sentences.zh: 土豆很淀粉，所以做土豆泥特别好吃。

sentences.en: The pasta was a bit too starchy and gummy on my plate.
sentences.zh: 面条有点太淀粉了，在我的盘子里粘糊糊的。

senses.zh: 含淀粉的；浆糊状的；刻板的
